mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (operator_id, operator_name, action, target_type, target_id, reason, before_value, after_value, ip) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{ip})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log
AND (action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{action}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR target_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{action}, '%') ESCAPE '!')
